    //guard to prevent error when SLA task creation engine runs twice by design. This was triggering state validation on the second pass, but there is no values for previous availble.
    if (!previous.getValue('state')) {
        gs.info('State transition validation skipped - no previous state available.\nCurrent state: ' + current.getValue('state') + ' - previous state: ' + previous.getValue('state') + ' - isNewRecord: ' + current.isNewRecord());
        return;
    }


    //allow save if close code is false positive and any state except eradication
    if (current.getValue('close_code') === 'false_positive' && current.getValue('state') === '34') {
        if (previous.getValue('state') === '13') {
            gs.addErrorMessage('Incidents cannot be resolved directly from Eradication - progress to Recovery first.')
            current.setAbortAction(true);
        }
        return;
    }

    //allow save if state transition is valid
    var validStateTransition = {
        '1': ['11'],
        '11': ['12', '15'],
        '12': ['13', '11', '15'],
        '13': ['14', '12', '11', '15'],
        '14': ['3', '13', '12', '11', '15', '4'],
        '15': ['11', '12', '13', '14'],
		'4': ['3', '11'],
        '3': []
    };
    if (validStateTransition[previous.getValue('state')].indexOf(current.getValue('state')) !== -1) {
        return;
    } else {
        gs.addErrorMessage('Invalid state transition - changing State from ' + previous.getDisplayValue('state') + ' to ' + current.getDisplayValue('state') + ' is not permitted.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-09 08:57:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>18ec229a83a28b1044779cb6feaad310</sys_id><sys_mod_count>18</sys_mod_count><sys_name>State transition validation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_18ec229a83a28b1044779cb6feaad310</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-02 09:28:56</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=18ec229a83a28b1044779cb6feaad310"/></record_update>
